items.description: The Satellite sneaker is handmade from a combination of LWG-certified leather, suede and oval mesh. It is set on dual-density AXLFoam® midsoles for increased shock absorption and rebound. This maximalist model is finished with taped trims, zig-zag embroidery, and a branded bubble in silver at the heel.
items.title: Satellite Runner

items.description: The Orbit Vintage sneaker is handmade in Portugal from panels of LWG-certified leather and suede in contrasting shades. This model is lined with a recycled polyester and microfiber-blend, and set on platform soles that are custom-molded using partly recycled rubber.
items.title: Orbit Sneaker

items.description: The Genesis Neo Runner is an evolution of one of our signature sneaker models – the original vintage-inspired silhouette has been reworked for a sleek, sculpted finish. This lightweight pair is handcrafted from panels of leather and textile, and stamped with gold branding.
items.title: Genesis Neo Runner

items.description: Just like the Area sneaker, the eponymous Area sandal pays homage to ‘90s basketball footwear. Crafted from leather and suede, it’s fitted with a webbing slingback strap and custom buckle for a utilitarian finish.
items.title: Area Sandal

items.description:
The Halo jacket is made from lightweight recycled polyester that’s filled with re-used down and feathers and features a screen-printed logo. Designed to lock in warmth, it has a high funnel neck and hidden snap-fastening cuffs. This piece comes with a matching bag so that it can be easily stowed away. Scan the QR code on the label of this puffer jacket to trace its journey.

This jacket is designed to be worn in the city, so it isn’t waterproof but only slightly water repellent. If you find yourself in a downpour, make sure to dry your jacket properly to avoid mold or stains.

The model is 183 cm / 6 ft and wears a size M.
items.title: Halo Down Jacket

items.description:
The Micro Bee Bird sweater is crafted from organic cotton and embroidered with our signature winged motif – a symbol of freedom, it debuted in a 2017 collection.

This product is made from a delicate fabric with a unique finish. Please handle it with care.

The model is 187 cm / 6’1.5 ft and wears a size M.
items.title: Micro Bee Bird Sweatshirt

items.description:
The Observer puffer jacket is made from lightweight recycled polyester that’s quilted to keep the re-used down and feather fill evenly distributed. Screen-printed at the chest, it has a stand collar and adjustable velcro-fastening cuffs to lock in warmth. This piece comes with a matching bag so that it can be easily stowed away. Scan the QR code on the  label of this puffer jacket to trace its journey.

This jacket is designed to be worn in the city, so it isn’t waterproof but only slightly water repellent. If you find yourself in a downpour, make sure to dry your jacket properly to avoid mold or stains.

The model is 183 cm / 6 ft and wears a size M.
items.title: Observer Puffer Jacket

items.description: The Dice Lo sneaker combines vintage and modern design details for a timeless, easy-to-style silhouette. Handcrafted from premium suede and recycled polyester, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and a gold logo.
items.title: Dice Lo Sneaker

items.description:
The Dice Lo sneaker combines vintage and modern design details for a timeless, easy-to-style silhouette. Handcrafted from premium leather, suede and recycled polyester, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and a gold logo.

The surface of the vintage effect leather will wear off and expose the natural base leather for a worn effect. Rubbing while cleaning, in particular if wet, will accentuate the worn effect. If this is not desired, clean gently with dabbing movements and dry cloth to avoid abrasion on the surface.
items.title: Dice Lo Sneaker

items.description:
The Gil shorts are tailored from textured bouclé in a classic, regular profile. Our seasonal branded label finishes this pair.

Due to the natural characteristics of this material, small fibers may shed during wear. Handle with care to preserve the original appearance of this piece for as long as possible.

The model is 185 cm / 6”1 ft and wears a size M.
items.title: Gil Boucle Shorts

items.description: The Slow Shearling Runner’s layered, low-profile silhouette takes on a new dimension with an all-over suede construction and real shearling lining — a first for the style. Inspired by the Marathon Runner, the upper is built from rich suede panels with knit-inspired details that nod to our ready-to-wear collections. Handmade in Portugal, it’s finished with debossed bubble branding, a 7mm rubber sole, and European sizing. The shearling-lined interior brings added warmth and comfort to the deconstructed design.
items.title: Slow Shearling Runner

items.description:
The Area Lo sneaker pays homage to ‘90s basketball styles. Handcrafted from premium leather and calf hair, it has paneled uppers finished with perforations and heel spoilers.

This sneaker is crafted from calf hair; a refined, naturally delicate material chosen for its unique texture. Some shedding over time is normal and not considered a defect. 

To keep them looking their best, store your sneakers in the dust bag when not in use and avoid rough or wet conditions. For cleaning, gently brush the hair in its natural direction with a soft-bristled brush. Avoid moisture and allow to air dry if needed. With a little extra care, your sneakers will age beautifully.
